title: Complete alternative-power dossier: later granted-knowledge correction and actual dependency/retention boundaries
head: 2ddf2f0ea4b7d5eb10d7fc3a947d76da2739f748

reviews.classification: complete alternative-power dossier and later edition-qualified LOTM trace correcting universal learning/recovery assumptions
reviews.disposition:
Complete review covers all428 input lines: eight main cases, biology supplement/four traits, eighteen families, six lifecycle contracts, loopsA–E and utility example, local-source/persistence/trap tables, three acquisition leads, and the full later LOTM follow-up with seven sampled pathway identities, five interactions and every local locator row. All original ideas, chapter pointers, source limits and corrections remain.

**The later LOTM correction is substantive.** The early potion lesson separates initiation from external lore, but later passages in this dossier explicitly record abilities arriving with knowledge. Do not turn the early example into a universal practice-from-zero gate. Individual acting experience, taught control, granted capability and complete expertise remain different. The later trace strengthens acting evidence while preserving the speaker, hypotheses, individual variation and edition qualification. It also explicitly rejects universal safe recovery: specific calming/isolation examples do not cure every loss of control. Current [lead-life rules](LEAD_LIFE_RULES.md), [skills/learning](SKILLS_AND_LEARNING_CONSIDERATIONS_2026-10-18.md) and selected world owners govern actual mechanisms; this reconciliation adds no class tree or new readable-source claim.

**Availability is not reading or authenticity.** The local catalog/OPF and intact1394-main-story target scan are historical structural observations;1450 archive members include notes/announcements rather than1450 story chapters. The completion marker does not establish bonus/sequel coverage, authentic transcription or a fully read/qualified first novel. Early official full chapters, previews, selected local bodies and later member/volume-relative locators have different scope. Keep both title/chapter and member identity because suffixes drift with inserted notes. The seven pathway identities are sampled, not every stage/all22 pathways. The specific authenticated-edition question remains a source-owner issue, not authorization to fetch or reread now. The other books' prologue, compendium, author lore/annotation, official guide, developer posts and author recap similarly support only their stated contrasts; popularity/acclaim and current availability were not reverified.

**Useful dependencies do not imply a compulsory price.** Formula/ingredients/permission/actual skill, owned organism/food/activation energy, invested reserve/consumed fuel, body/learned method/equipped adaptation, oath/patron/faction and installed facility/portable design are distinct causes. The single utility/compact/loadout slots, all-companions-have-tradeoffs, free-damage prohibition, equal baseline access, recoverable contamination, guaranteed mundane substitute and capped debt/hidden-trap prohibition are local prototype policies. Actual worlds may grant superior bodies, free strong help, irreversible effects, unknown intent or a genuine clean boon under [current direction](USER_VISION.md). A means may bypass a usual stage; knowing a drawback does not remove it. Transfer commands and consent are not identical to absence of coercion. Memory, experience and a social relation have actual owners and do not automatically follow an item or reset together.

**Loops are still proposals.** Licensed relic first/occult next/workshop later is a September30 recommendation, not today's route order. The lantern can share an initial command contract with a symbiote without proving identical identity, care or growth. Workshop completion switching, protected stock, one-time launch ration and typed quotes are useful contract examples; no blanket ban on profitable arbitrage or a strong feedback loop follows. Save integrity preserves actual stock, custody and settled rewards rather than enforcing an unsolicited anti-exploit rule. Scarcity, depletion, oath breach, outside-world incompatibility and NPC reaction need their real mechanisms. Story dialogue/flavor remains useful even when it does not issue a new typed reward.

**Persistence and display use existing owners.** The proposed alternative_power namespace is not a selected schema or a reason to duplicate inventory, reputation, knowledge, clocks or reward authority. Quote, commitment, reserved versus spent material, unused refund, action result and durable publication stay separate. A supposedly safe withdrawal must have a real route; a preview does not guarantee return or reveal unknown truth. Ordinary active-time, pause and future catch-up/decay policies retain their selected scopes; no timestamps/offline hazards are added by citing a source. Cross-world eligibility/fuel/substrate/local-law questions are useful without imposing one conversion tax or permission whitelist on every effect. Current [architecture](ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md), [UI rules](UI_RULES.md), AD36/AD43 and optional human review govern a chosen slice.

Reopen a named case/family/loop/locator for an actual selected consumer and current source/runtime evidence. No novel/PDF/external page, library metadata, primary corpus, source code or gameplay was newly examined; no test/build/browser, acquisition, personal save, deletion, relocation, commit or push occurred.
